derivation: a primitive root; to be complete; but used only as denominative from H8380 (תָּאוֹם),
def: to be (causatively, make) twinned, i.e. (figuratively) duplicate or (architectural) jointed

occurrences.text: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.
Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
